identity.title: Effect of transcutaneous electrical acupoint stimulation on postoperative cognitive function in older patients with lung cancer: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial

design.population: Adults >=65; thoracoscopic pulmonary resection under general anesthesia
design.intervention: DU20 and bilateral PC6/LI4/ST36, 2/100Hz 10-30mA, 30min preinduction through surgery end
design.attrition: TEAS:2 open conversions,1 unilateral pulmonary resection,3 second operations,2 declined follow-up,1 death. Sham:4 open conversions,1 operation<2h,1 benign tumor,3 deaths. All excluded from analyses.

results.location: p6 Fig3B visually inspected; no numerical labels

source_conflicts: p2 exclusions include diseases present in Table1.
PONV table has no acute interval.
